capture_plan.protocol: One public topcall per recipe/profile only after independent safety and root GO; existing durable begin/end journal, no retry after consumption. Freeze controller/source/GO/setup before calls. Actual retained-runtime native Windows Git locator required at frozen Git-dependent entry point. semantics: False slices returns exact image immediately, before image attributes, axes or copy truth; copy=True does not override identity.
No order keyword. axes documented int is not accepted by the nonempty implementation because len(axes) is required. Negative axes rejected.
Default axes spans ndim and may be longer than slices; only too many slices rejects. Explicit axes length must equal slices length. Uniqueness checked before range.

Zip slices and axes in supplied order. Pair unpacking and protocol operations remain observable. Negative bounds use modulo dimension before order and range checks, including zero-dimension remainder behavior.
Order rejects a>b after modulo. Range checks a<0 or b>dimension; no generic Python clamp normalization. Float/None/scalar errors preserve source phase.

Image indexed once with full-rank tuple of basic slices. Copy truth evaluated after getitem. Copy occurs only if requested and result.base is not None, using result.copy() default C. Owned custom results skip copying.

No asarray/provider computation is inserted. Preserve exact error class/text, events, warnings, FP policy and callbacks; object copy is shallow. Sharing, identity, relative offsets and declared mutation are separately observed.
